targetText: What the working man sells is not directly his labour, but his labouring power, the temporary disposal of which he makes over to the capitalist.
explanation: The crucial distinction in political economy: workers sell their temporary capacity to work (labor-power), not the finished products of their work.

targetText: After what has been said, it will be seen that the value of labouring power is determined by the value of the necessaries required to produce, develop, maintain, and perpetuate the labouring power.
explanation: The value of labor-power equals the total value of commodities necessary to sustain, train, and reproduce the working class.
